title: OverLevelEnchant
body:
🪄 OverLevelEnchant — Go Beyond Vanilla Enchanting!
💎 Description

OverLevelEnchant supercharges Minecraft’s enchanting system, allowing players to go beyond the vanilla level cap and unlock enchantments up to level 100+!

At normal levels, the enchantment table behaves as usual (up to level 30).
But once a player surpasses level 35, the enchantment table begins granting mysterious, powerful “? Enchantments” — like Efficiency 25, Unbreaking 40, or even Sharpness 100!

Perfect for Lifesteal SMPs, custom RPG servers, or progression-based worlds that want to reward long-term players.

⚙️ Features

✅ Works exactly like a normal enchantment table until level 30
✅ Unlocks OverLevel Enchantments past level 35
✅ Configurable boost level and enchantment cap
✅ Dynamic scaling system for fair and exciting gameplay
✅ Fully customizable messages and behavior via config.yml
✅ Compatible with Paper / Spigot / Purpur (1.17 → 1.21+)
